allowed_validation_only_adjustment: each soft weight 0.5x to 2.0x; manufacturing remains hard; no adjustment from frozen tests
normalization: each continuous term divided by max(pooled R1/R2 validation median absolute residual, validation IQR, epsilon); tests excluded

terms.leakage: Tyy+Txy+Tyx from complete raw complex J
terms.manufacturing: hard infeasibility gate; not a soft optical score
terms.rank: sigma2/sigma1 from complete raw complex J
terms.spectral_instability: endpoint phase drift + phase slope + phase curvature + bin-order instability + throughput variation
terms.throughput_penalty: normalized shortfall of selected-channel Txx against clean-training reference
